EmailTemplate.name: INTL Priority Tasks List
EmailTemplate.subject: Complete your Priority Tasks in My ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations on your decision to attend Arizona State University! Please complete your Priority Tasks as soon as possible by logging in to My ASU (http://my.asu.edu).
Your Priority Tasks may include:
1. Pay the enrollment deposit – Once you pay this, you can confirm your housing preferences and contact your academic advisor to schedule your classes (https://housing.asu.edu/). 2. English proficiency – Have your TOEFL or IELTS score sent directly to ASU. 3. MMR immunization – Email proof of immunization to measles@asu.edu (https://eoss.asu.edu/health/immunization). 4. Financial guarantee – Email financial guarantee form to fg@asu.edu. 5. Financial documents – Email financial documents showing at least $41,870 to fg@asu.edu (https://international.asu.edu/financialguarantee). 6. I-20 questions – Answer the questions "Are you in the USA?" and "Choose I-20 delivery option." We highly recommend selecting the expedited delivery option for two reasons: 1. If you choose traditional mail, there will not be a method of tracking the expected delivery date or to find a lost package. 2. It can take several weeks via traditional mail, causing delay in getting your Visa interview set up and your I-20 issued.
Final foreign high school transcript – Bring your official transcripts (clearly showing your graduate date) to Admission Services when you arrive on campus (see map: https://maps.asu.edu/?id=120&mrkIid=63156).
For more details about the items listed above, please refer to our international undergraduate admission requirements at https://students.asu.edu/international/future/undergrad or contact me. I am here to help you through the admission process.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
